translations.zh-Hant: 跟著裝置語言；簡體中文改用繁體中文，其他沒有譯文的語言用英文
translations.en: Follows your device language: Traditional Chinese for Simplified Chinese, English for other languages without a translation

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀回語言設定，請重新選擇。
translations.en: Could not verify the saved language. Please select it again.

translations.zh-Hant: 個人檔案記錄你的背景與偏好，最多 20 條。修改會在下一次任務使用，當次要求優先。
translations.en: Your profile keeps your background and preferences, up to 20 entries. Changes apply from your next task; what you ask in a task comes first.

translations.zh-Hant: 「使用記憶」已關閉；個人檔案仍會保留，但不會加入對話。
translations.en: “Use memory” is off. Your profile is kept but isn’t added to conversations.

translations.zh-Hant: 資料目前無法讀取；原檔保留且不會被覆寫。
translations.en: The data can’t be read right now. The original file is kept and won’t be overwritten.

translations.zh-Hant: 歷史紀錄不會加入對話；清除所有記憶與 Skills 也會清除個人檔案及其歷史。
translations.en: History isn’t added to conversations. Clearing all memories and skills also clears your profile and its history.

translations.zh-Hant: 一句話描述背景或偏好
translations.en: Describe your background or a preference in one sentence

translations.zh-Hant: %1$lld／160 字元；部分符號會占多個字元。
translations.en: %1$lld/160 characters; some symbols count as more than one.

translations.zh-Hant: 請使用單句，不要包含換行、密碼、驗證碼或金鑰。
translations.en: Use one sentence, with no line breaks, passwords, verification codes or keys.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型提出以下個人檔案修改。請核對是否符合你這次的要求；核准後會儲存，下次對話開始時生效。
translations.en: The model proposes this profile change. Check that it matches what you asked for this time. Once you approve, it’s saved and applies from your next conversation.

translations.zh-Hant: 這條內容將不再用於後續對話；修改歷史會保留。
translations.en: This entry won’t be used in later conversations; its history is kept.
Save a note about this website

translations.zh-Hant: 記下此網站的操作方式或注意事項
translations.en: How this site works, or what to watch for

translations.zh-Hant: 會一併保留本頁的一小段原文作為來源。網站內容不會自動變成你的個人記憶。
translations.en: A short excerpt of this page is kept as the source. Website content never becomes your personal memory on its own.

translations.zh-Hant: 先在瀏覽器開啟網頁，才能建立有來源的知識。
translations.en: Open a page in the browser first, so the note has a source.

translations.zh-Hant: 已停用：同一步驟連續兩次不符
translations.en: Turned off: the same step didn’t match twice in a row

translations.zh-Hant: 重走已儲存的網頁路線？
將開啟 %1$@ 的 %2$lld 個已記錄步驟。只讀取網頁；內容不符便停止，不會提交表單。
translations.en: Opens %1$@ and follows %2$lld recorded steps. It only reads pages, stops when something doesn’t match, and never submits forms.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務、模型或金鑰身分與目前設定不同；僅供檢視，不會帶入目前服務。
translations.en: The model service, model or key differs from your current settings. You can read this conversation, but it won’t be carried into the current service.

translations.zh-Hant: 會移除已保存的問答、附件擷取文字與引文；已確認的記憶與個人檔案保留。
translations.en: This removes the saved exchanges, the text taken from attachments and the quotations. Confirmed memories and your profile are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 請核對這次記憶修改。核准後會儲存，並提供撤銷按鈕。
translations.en: Check this memory change. Once you approve, it’s saved and you get an Undo button.

translations.zh-Hant: 這條操作偏好會先列為待確認；需另外批准後，後續任務才會參考。
translations.en: This procedure is listed for review first. Later tasks use it only after you approve it separately.

translations.zh-Hant: 在瀏覽器手動下載後，可在這裡查看進度、分享或刪除檔案。
translations.en: After you download a file in the browser, you can follow its progress, share it or delete it here.

translations.zh-Hant: 開啟待審計畫，尚未讀取檔案
translations.en: Opens a plan for you to review; the file isn’t read yet

translations.zh-Hant: 最多保留 %1$lld 筆下載，同時下載 %2$lld 筆。單檔上限 %3$@，總量上限 %4$@。
translations.en: Keeps up to %1$lld downloads, %2$lld at a time. Up to %3$@ per file and %4$@ in total.

translations.zh-Hant: 檔案保存在此 App 中。請點選「開啟或分享」選擇其他 App，或儲存到「檔案」。下載中離開 App 可能中斷；不會自動開啟檔案。
translations.en: Files are kept in this app. Tap “Open or share” to pick another app or save to Files. Leaving the app during a download may interrupt it. Files never open on their own.

translations.zh-Hant: 確定刪除「%1$@」？此 App 內的檔案會一併刪除，已分享的副本不受影響。
translations.en: Delete “%1$@”? The file in this app is deleted too; copies you already shared aren’t affected.

translations.zh-Hant: 下載儲存空間目前無法使用。請稍後再試。
translations.en: Download storage isn’t available right now. Try again later.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法下載此網址，或重新導向不符合下載規則。
translations.en: This address can’t be downloaded, or a redirect broke the download rules.

translations.zh-Hant: 研究模式不會下載檔案；請回到瀏覽器手動下載。
translations.en: Research mode doesn’t download files. Go back to the browser and download it yourself.

translations.zh-Hant: 下載數量已達上限，請先取消下載或刪除不需要的檔案。
translations.en: You’ve reached the download limit. Cancel a download or delete files you don’t need.

translations.zh-Hant: 檔案或下載資料夾已超過容量上限。
translations.en: The file or the downloads folder is over its size limit.

translations.zh-Hant: 下載檔案路徑或內容無法驗證。
translations.en: The downloaded file’s path or content couldn’t be verified.

translations.zh-Hant: 下載紀錄無法讀取，已保留原有檔案。
translations.en: The download list couldn’t be read. The files were kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先確認是否刪除檔案。
請先取消下載，再刪除紀錄。
translations.en: Cancel the download before deleting its record.

translations.zh-Hant: 找不到已完成的下載檔案。
translations.en: The completed download can’t be found.

translations.zh-Hant: 下載未完成，請檢查連線後重新從網頁下載。
translations.en: The download didn’t finish. Check your connection and download it again from the page.

translations.zh-Hant: 下載重新導向次數過多，已停止。
translations.en: Too many redirects; the download stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 未能清除未完成檔案，將在下次啟動時重試。
translations.en: Couldn’t clear unfinished files. It will try again next launch.

translations.zh-Hant: 這項執行能力尚未連接。
請重新選取可讀取的單一 PDF 檔案。
translations.en: Select one readable PDF file again.

translations.zh-Hant: 檔案超過 10 MiB，請先縮小檔案。
translations.en: The file is over 10 MiB. Make it smaller first.

translations.zh-Hant: 這個檔案不是可讀取的 PDF。
translations.en: This file isn’t a readable PDF.

translations.zh-Hant: PDF 已鎖定，請提供正確密碼後重新建立計畫。
translations.en: The PDF is locked. Enter the correct password and create the plan again.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁碼格式或範圍不正確，請使用例如 1,3-5 的格式。
translations.en: The page numbers or range aren’t valid. Use a format like 1,3-5.
Up to 200 pages at a time.

translations.zh-Hant: 文字結果超過 2 MiB，請縮小頁碼範圍。
translations.en: The text result is over 2 MiB. Choose fewer pages.

translations.zh-Hant: 此步驟尚未取得單次核准，或核准已使用。
translations.en: This step isn’t approved yet, or its approval was already used.

translations.zh-Hant: 核准已逾期，請重新檢視此步驟。
translations.en: The approval expired. Review this step again.

translations.zh-Hant: 計畫已變更或結束，請重新建立計畫。
translations.en: The plan changed or ended. Create it again.

translations.zh-Hant: 此計畫正在執行，請等候完成。
translations.en: This plan is running. Wait for it to finish.

translations.zh-Hant: 記憶資料暫時無法讀取，原檔保留且不會被覆寫。請解鎖後重試。
translations.en: Memory data can’t be read right now. The original file is kept and won’t be overwritten. Unlock the device and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 個人檔案已儲存，下一次對話任務開始時生效。
translations.en: Profile saved. It applies from your next conversation task.

translations.zh-Hant: 已批准這條操作偏好，後續任務可以參考。
translations.en: Procedure approved. Later tasks can use it.

translations.zh-Hant: 已拒絕這條操作偏好；有可用撤銷紀錄時恢復修改前內容。
translations.en: Procedure declined. If there’s an undo record, the earlier content is restored.

translations.zh-Hant: 已清除個人檔案、記憶、技能、網站知識與路線，並更新加密金鑰；模型和 MCP 設定保留。
translations.en: Cleared your profile, memories, skills, website notes and routes, and renewed the encryption key. Model and MCP settings are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 資料已清除並更新加密金鑰，但舊金鑰清理未完成；請解鎖後再次執行清除。
translations.en: Data cleared and the encryption key renewed, but removing the old key didn’t finish. Unlock the device and clear again.

translations.zh-Hant: 已讀取記憶，但使用次數未能儲存；原記憶保留。
translations.en: Memory was read, but its use count couldn’t be saved. The memory is unchanged.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆已完成；目前模型連線無法確認記憶整理請求的生命週期，本次未整理。
translations.en: Reply finished. The current model connection couldn’t confirm the memory tidy-up request, so memory wasn’t tidied this time.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆已完成；學習資料已在其他位置變更，這次記憶整理未儲存。請重新讀取並確認。
translations.en: Reply finished. Learning data changed elsewhere, so this memory tidy-up wasn’t saved. Reload and check.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆已完成；學習資料正在其他位置儲存，這次記憶整理未儲存。請稍後確認。
translations.en: Reply finished. Learning data is being saved elsewhere, so this memory tidy-up wasn’t saved. Check again later.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆已完成；這次記憶整理未完成，既有資料不變。你也可以到記憶與資料手寫一條。
translations.en: Reply finished. This memory tidy-up didn’t finish and existing data is unchanged. You can also add a memory yourself in Memory & Data.

translations.zh-Hant: 網站資料未儲存；請檢查內容、來源與版本，既有資料保留。
translations.en: Website data wasn’t saved. Check the content, source and version; existing data is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料未儲存；原有技能、網站知識與路線保留。
translations.en: Learning data wasn’t saved. Existing skills, website notes and routes are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 任務已停止；技能結果紀錄未能儲存，既有資料保留。
translations.en: The task stopped. The skill result record couldn’t be saved; existing data is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料正在其他位置儲存；本次未儲存，原有資料保留。請稍後再試。
translations.en: Learning data is being saved elsewhere. Nothing was saved this time and existing data is kept. Try again later.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料已在其他位置變更；本次未儲存，原有資料保留。請重新讀取並再次確認。
translations.en: Learning data changed elsewhere. Nothing was saved this time and existing data is kept. Reload and confirm again.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入單句、1–160 字元的個人檔案；不可包含換行、密碼、驗證碼或金鑰等敏感資料。
translations.en: Enter one sentence of 1–160 characters, with no line breaks and no sensitive data such as passwords, verification codes or keys.

translations.zh-Hant: 這條個人檔案已經存在。
個人檔案已達 20 條上限，請先整理。
translations.en: Your profile has reached 20 entries. Remove some first.

translations.zh-Hant: 指定片段必須只出現在一條現用檔案中，而且只出現一次；請重新選擇。
translations.en: The chosen text must appear exactly once, in a single active entry. Choose again.

translations.zh-Hant: 個人檔案狀態無效；原資料保留，變更未套用。
translations.en: The profile is in an invalid state. The original data is kept and the change wasn’t applied.

translations.zh-Hant: 密碼、驗證碼、金鑰與其他敏感資料不能存入記憶。
translations.en: Passwords, verification codes, keys and other sensitive data can’t be saved to memory.
A memory must be 1 to 200 characters.

translations.zh-Hant: 記憶已達 500 條上限，請先整理。
translations.en: Memory is full at 500 entries. Delete a few first.

translations.zh-Hant: 資料已有新變更，舊的整理結果未套用。
translations.en: The data has changed since, so the earlier tidy-up wasn’t applied.

translations.zh-Hant: 記憶變更未完成，請檢查內容後重試。
translations.en: The memory change didn’t finish. Check the content and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能引用了此版本尚未提供的工具，未匯入或啟用。
translations.en: The skill uses a tool this version doesn’t have, so it wasn’t imported or turned on.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能內含可能的敏感資料，未儲存。
translations.en: The skill may contain sensitive data, so it wasn’t saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 原技能已被修改，請重新檢查更新內容。
translations.en: The original skill has changed. Review the update again.

translations.zh-Hant: 同名技能已有待確認草稿，請先處理。
translations.en: A skill with this name already has a draft to review. Handle it first.

translations.zh-Hant: 這個名稱保留給內建技能，請使用不同的個人技能名稱。
translations.en: This name is reserved for a built-in skill. Give your skill a different name.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能須包含入口、步驟、容易出錯的地方、怎樣算辦成、什麼時候停下交給使用者五個段落。
translations.en: A skill needs five sections: where to start, the steps, what tends to go wrong, what counts as done, and when to stop and hand over to the user.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能全文超過 4,000 字上限。
translations.en: The skill text is over the 4,000-character limit.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能或版本紀錄已達儲存上限；現有資料保留，這次變更未儲存。
translations.en: Skills or their version history reached the storage limit. Existing data is kept; this change wasn’t saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能格式或狀態不符，未儲存；請檢查名稱、描述與全文。
translations.en: The skill’s format or state isn’t valid, so it wasn’t saved. Check the name, description and full text.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法儲存記憶資料，變更未套用。請解鎖裝置後重試。
translations.en: Couldn’t save memory data, so the change wasn’t applied. Unlock the device and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 刪除未儲存，原對話仍保留。請解鎖後重試。
translations.en: The deletion wasn’t saved and the conversation is still there. Unlock the device and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取加密對話，原檔保留且不會被覆寫。請解鎖後重新讀取。
translations.en: Couldn’t read the encrypted conversations. The original file is kept and won’t be overwritten. Unlock the device and reload.

translations.zh-Hant: 這次要建立或修改什麼做法？
translations.en: What procedure do you want to create or change?

translations.zh-Hant: 請寫下你的要求。接著可查閱原始或個人技能、編寫全文，再核對內容並核准儲存。
translations.en: Write down what you want. Then you can look up built-in or personal skills, write the full text, check it and approve saving it.

translations.zh-Hant: 這是手動編寫流程；不會呼叫模型或連線。儲存後先試用，工具操作仍須各自核准。
translations.en: You write this yourself: no model is called and nothing goes online. A saved skill starts as a trial, and each tool action still needs your approval.

translations.zh-Hant: 找到相近的個人技能時，先讀全文再修改；停用的技能仍會列出供查閱。
translations.en: If you find a similar personal skill, read its full text before changing it. Disabled skills are still listed so you can read them.

translations.zh-Hant: 內容供你查閱，讀取不會啟用技能或執行工具。
translations.en: This is for reading. Reading it doesn’t turn the skill on or run any tool.

translations.zh-Hant: 名稱使用小寫英文字母、數字與連字號。填寫描述與五個段落，全文上限 4,000 字。
translations.en: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens for the name. Fill in the description and the five sections, up to 4,000 characters in all.

translations.zh-Hant: 請勿放入密碼或金鑰。使用反引號標示的工具須為本版本提供的能力。
translations.en: Don’t include passwords or keys. Tools in backticks must be ones this version provides.
Replaces the personal skill with this name

translations.zh-Hant: 尚未儲存。請核對完整內容；核准後會儲存為「試用中」，不會執行其中步驟。
translations.en: Not saved yet. Check the full text. Once you approve, it’s saved as a trial and none of its steps run.

translations.zh-Hant: 已更新個人技能 · 試用中
已新增個人技能 · 試用中
可到「記憶與資料 › 技能」查看、停用或管理。尚未驗證這份做法的實際成果。
translations.en: See, disable or manage it in Memory & Data › Skills. Whether this procedure works hasn’t been checked yet.

translations.zh-Hant: 請提供本次要建立或修改技能的原始要求。
translations.en: Give the original request for the skill you want to create or change.

translations.zh-Hant: 引用的要求與本次使用者原話不一致，未儲存。
translations.en: The quoted request doesn’t match what you wrote this time, so nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能儲存目前無法使用。
translations.en: Skill storage isn’t available right now.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消本次技能寫作，未執行儲存。
translations.en: Skill writing was cancelled and nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 找不到指定技能，請重新查詢。
translations.en: That skill can’t be found. Search again.

translations.zh-Hant: 同名技能已存在；請先讀取全文與目前版本。
translations.en: A skill with this name exists. Read its full text and current version first.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能在讀取後已變更，請重新讀取再修改。
translations.en: The skill changed after you read it. Read it again before changing it.

translations.zh-Hant: 同名技能目前停用，請先到技能清單處理；本次不會重新啟用它。
translations.en: A disabled skill has this name. Handle it in the skill list first; this won’t turn it back on.

translations.zh-Hant: 同名技能已有待確認草稿，請先處理該草稿。
translations.en: A skill with this name has a draft to review. Handle that draft first.

translations.zh-Hant: 草稿已變更，請重新檢視並核准完整內容。
translations.en: The draft changed. Review and approve the full text again.

translations.zh-Hant: 需要核准本次完整草稿；先前的核准不能重複使用。
translations.en: This full draft needs your approval; an earlier approval can’t be reused.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次核准已逾時，請重新檢視草稿。
translations.en: This approval timed out. Review the draft again.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能資料已更新，請重新檢視本次修改。
translations.en: Skill data was updated. Review this change again.

translations.zh-Hant: 可用工具已變更，請重新檢視草稿後再核准。
translations.en: The available tools changed. Review the draft again before approving.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能未能儲存；既有資料保留，請重新檢視後再試。
translations.en: The skill couldn’t be saved. Existing data is kept; review it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次查閱已達上限，請重新開始技能寫作。
translations.en: You’ve reached this session’s lookup limit. Start writing the skill again.

translations.zh-Hant: 輸入要建立或修改的做法。
translations.en: Describe the procedure you want to create or change.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次協作已停止，尚未儲存。
translations.en: This session stopped; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在請模型協作（第 %1$lld 回合）…
草稿待你核對，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The draft is ready for you to check; nothing is saved yet.
Waiting for more details from you.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型已結束，本次尚未儲存。
translations.en: The model finished; nothing was saved this time.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能協作未完成，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The skill session didn’t finish; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型設定或技能資料已變更，本次協作已停止；請重新開始。
translations.en: The model settings or skill data changed, so this session stopped. Start again.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先在模型設定儲存服務網址、模型名稱與 API Key。
translations.en: First save the service address, model name and API key in model settings.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法取得已設定模型的憑證，尚未開始協作。請解鎖裝置並檢查模型設定。
translations.en: Couldn’t get the configured model’s credentials, so the session didn’t start. Unlock the device and check model settings.

translations.zh-Hant: 試用中；尚未驗證這份做法的實際成果。工具操作仍須各自核准。
translations.en: Trial: whether this procedure works hasn’t been checked yet. Each tool action still needs your approval.

translations.zh-Hant: 核准後才會儲存為「試用中」。這一步不會執行技能。
translations.en: It’s saved as a trial only after you approve. This step doesn’t run the skill.
Ask the model to help write a skill

translations.zh-Hant: 說明要建立、匯入或修改的做法。要求及本次查閱的技能內容會傳給已設定的模型；請勿填入密碼或金鑰。
translations.en: Describe the procedure to create, import or change. Your request and the skill text read in this session go to the configured model. Don’t include passwords or keys.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型會查詢、讀取並準備完整草稿，由你核准後儲存。內建原文的腳本與其他 App 操作不會因此啟用。
translations.en: The model searches, reads and prepares a full draft, which is saved after you approve it. Scripts in the built-in source and actions in other apps are not turned on by this.
Write a skill with the model

translations.zh-Hant: 技能協作的執行上限設定無效。
translations.en: The skill session’s limits aren’t valid.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回傳的技能工具格式不符，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The model’s skill tool call wasn’t in the right format; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次技能協作狀態已變更，請重新開始。
translations.en: The skill session’s state changed. Start again.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先讀取本版本的技能編寫原文。
translations.en: Read this version’s skill-writing source first.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先查詢是否已有相同用途的技能。
translations.en: First search for a skill with the same purpose.

translations.zh-Hant: 只能讀取本次技能目錄或查詢結果列出的技能。
translations.en: Only skills listed in this catalog or in the search results can be read.

translations.zh-Hant: 更新版本與本次讀取的技能不符，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The update doesn’t match the skill that was read; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 只能讀取這份內建技能列出的原始附件。
translations.en: Only the original attachments listed for this built-in skill can be read.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次技能協作已達回合或資料上限，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The session reached its round or data limit; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型等待已達本次時間上限，尚未儲存。
translations.en: Waiting for the model hit this session’s time limit; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法連線至設定的模型，尚未儲存。
translations.en: Couldn’t reach the configured model; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 設定的模型服務拒絕要求，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The configured model service refused the request; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回覆不完整或格式無效，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The model’s reply was incomplete or invalid; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消技能協作，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The skill session was cancelled; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能草稿連續未通過檢查，尚未儲存；請調整要求後重新開始。
translations.en: The skill draft kept failing the checks; nothing was saved. Adjust your request and start again.

translations.zh-Hant: 選取檔案後檢視每一步，再分別核准。預設使用裝置上的 PDFKit。
translations.en: After you choose a file, review each step and approve it separately. PDFKit on the device is used by default.

translations.zh-Hant: 僅在獨立 PDF 查詢流程，確認模型目的服務後，讀取或逐字搜尋本次已擷取 PDF 的文字快照；引文需對應實際讀取。不開放任意路徑、workspace 或無上限讀取。
translations.en: Only in the separate PDF question flow, after you confirm the model service, can the model read or search the text snapshot of this extracted PDF; quotations must match what was actually read. No arbitrary paths, workspace or unlimited reading.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁碼，例如 1,3-5；留空代表全部
translations.en: Pages, e.g. 1,3-5; leave empty for all

translations.zh-Hant: 來源：此 App 的已完成下載。下載成功尚未授權讀取或擷取。
translations.en: Source: a completed download in this app. A finished download isn’t permission to read or extract it.

translations.zh-Hant: 建立下載 PDF 計畫
translations.en: Create a plan for the downloaded PDF

translations.zh-Hant: 選檔後，系統會先建立暫存副本並占用儲存空間，不會更動原檔。App 讀取與後續擷取仍需分別核准。App 最多讀取 10 MiB；系統複製的大小不受此上限限制。
translations.en: After you choose a file, the system first makes a temporary copy that uses storage; the original isn’t changed. Reading it in the app and extracting still need separate approvals. The app reads up to 10 MiB; the system’s copy has no such limit.

translations.zh-Hant: 選取 PDF 並匯入副本
translations.en: Select a PDF and import a copy

translations.zh-Hant: 只讀取本次選取的檔案，最多 10 MiB；不會掃描資料夾。
translations.en: Reads only the file you selected, up to 10 MiB. Folders aren’t scanned.
Extract the PDF on the device

translations.zh-Hant: 在裝置上以 PDFKit 擷取文字；不會上傳。
translations.en: Extracts the text on the device with PDFKit. Nothing is uploaded.

translations.zh-Hant: 能力已連接；此步驟仍需核准
translations.en: Ready; this step still needs your approval

translations.zh-Hant: 這是經過限定的 iOS 能力實作，並非完整執行原版技能。
translations.en: This is a limited iOS implementation, not a full run of the original skill.

translations.zh-Hant: 選取頁面沒有可擷取的文字，可能需要 OCR；此能力不提供 OCR。
translations.en: The selected pages have no text to extract and may need OCR, which this doesn’t provide.

translations.zh-Hant: 請對照原頁核對表格、多欄文字與引用；此結果未保證版面順序。
translations.en: Check tables, multi-column text and quotations against the original pages; the layout order isn’t guaranteed.

translations.zh-Hant: 文字結果過大，請縮小頁碼範圍後再匯出。
translations.en: The text is too large. Choose fewer pages and export again.

translations.zh-Hant: 文字已儲存至所選位置。
translations.en: Text saved to the location you chose.

translations.zh-Hant: 文字未能儲存，請重新選擇位置再試一次。
translations.en: The text couldn’t be saved. Choose a location and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消匯出，擷取結果仍保留。
translations.en: Export cancelled; the extracted text is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 這次擷取結果無法建立查詢快照，請確認已擷取可讀取的文字。
translations.en: Couldn’t make a snapshot of this result to ask about. Make sure readable text was extracted.

translations.zh-Hant: 未能取得選取的 PDF，請重新選取一個檔案。
translations.en: Couldn’t get the selected PDF. Select one file again.
Couldn’t select the file. Try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 下載檔案已刪除或變更，本次計畫已取消。請重新選取。
translations.en: The downloaded file was deleted or changed, so this plan was cancelled. Select it again.

translations.zh-Hant: 已讀取 %1$lld 位元組。請核准下一個步驟。
translations.en: Read %1$lld bytes. Approve the next step.

translations.zh-Hant: 選取 %1$lld 頁 · %2$lld 位元組文字
文件引文只來自這次擷取的文字；原 PDF 不會重新讀取。
translations.en: Quotations come only from this extracted text; the original PDF isn’t read again.
What do you want to know?

translations.zh-Hant: 確認目前設定的目的服務
開始後，問題、檔名、讀取片段與已啟用的個人檔案、相關記憶及適用技能會傳給上述服務。保存資料只作背景，不是文件證據或操作授權。回答不會自動儲存。
translations.en: Once you start, your question, the file name, the parts read, and your enabled profile, related memories and matching skills are sent to this service. Saved data is only background, not evidence from the document or permission to act. The answer isn’t saved automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: 傳送問題並查詢這份 PDF
translations.en: Send the question and search this PDF

translations.zh-Hant: 引文已核對本次實際讀過的範圍；這不表示全文已讀，或回答中的解讀均正確。
translations.en: Quotations were checked against what was actually read. That doesn’t mean the whole document was read or that the answer’s interpretation is right.

translations.zh-Hant: 原 PDF 第 %1$lld 頁 · 選取序號 %2$lld
回答與引文已儲存至所選位置。
translations.en: Answer and quotations saved to the location you chose.

translations.zh-Hant: 回答未能儲存，請重新選擇位置再試一次。
translations.en: The answer couldn’t be saved. Choose a location and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消匯出，回答與引文仍保留。
translations.en: Export cancelled; the answer and quotations are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 回答無法建立文字檔，原回答仍保留。
translations.en: Couldn’t make a text file of the answer; the answer is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入問題，並確認要傳送至哪個模型服務。
translations.en: Enter a question and confirm which model service to send it to.

translations.zh-Hant: 問題已更新，尚未傳送給模型。
translations.en: Question updated; not sent to the model yet.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法取得已設定的模型服務，請先儲存模型設定。
translations.en: Couldn’t get the configured model service. Save model settings first.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先確認目前設定的模型目的服務。
translations.en: Confirm the current model service first.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在依問題搜尋與分段讀取已核准的 PDF 文字…
translations.en: Searching and reading the approved PDF text in parts…

translations.zh-Hant: 正在請模型查詢（第 %1$lld 回合）…
搜尋找到 %1$lld 處；尚有其他符合位置。
translations.en: Search found %1$lld matches; there are more.

translations.zh-Hant: 已讀取原 PDF 第 %1$lld 頁的 %2$lld 位元組文字。
translations.en: Read %2$lld bytes of text from page %1$lld of the original PDF.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型指令格式無效，正在要求一次格式修正。
translations.en: The model’s command format was invalid; asking it once to fix the format.

translations.zh-Hant: 回答引用已與實際讀取的原文逐字核對，請再核對解讀是否正確。
translations.en: The answer’s quotations were checked word for word against the text actually read. Check that the interpretation is right.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型未完成這個問題；已擷取的 PDF 文字仍保留。
translations.en: The model didn’t finish this question; the extracted PDF text is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 已停止查詢，問題與已擷取的文字仍保留。
translations.en: Stopped; the question and the extracted text are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型設定已變更；請重新確認目的服務後再查詢。
translations.en: Model settings changed. Confirm the model service again before asking.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型設定已變更；已完成的回答仍保留，再次查詢前請重新確認目的服務。
translations.en: Model settings changed. The finished answer is kept; confirm the model service again before asking again.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次參考資料已撤銷；請確認目前設定與目的服務後重新查詢。
translations.en: This session’s reference data was withdrawn. Check the current settings and model service, then ask again.

translations.zh-Hant: 查詢已停止，問題與已擷取的 PDF 文字仍保留；晚到回覆不會更新結果。
translations.en: Stopped. The question and extracted PDF text are kept; a late reply won’t change the result.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法使用本次參考資料；請確認記憶與資料設定後重新查詢。
translations.en: This session’s reference data can’t be used. Check Memory & Data settings and ask again.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型設定或本次查詢已變更，請重新確認後再開始。
translations.en: The model settings or this question changed. Confirm again before starting.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法完成本次 PDF 查詢，未產生可驗證的回答。
translations.en: Couldn’t finish this PDF question; no verifiable answer was produced.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次查詢未完成，問題與已擷取的文字仍保留。
translations.en: This question didn’t finish; the question and extracted text are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: PDF 擷取結果無法驗證，請重新完成擷取。
translations.en: The PDF extraction couldn’t be verified. Extract it again.

translations.zh-Hant: 這份擷取結果沒有可查詢的文字；不提供 OCR。
translations.en: This extraction has no text to search; OCR isn’t provided.

translations.zh-Hant: 擷取文字超過 2 MiB，請縮小選取頁碼。
translations.en: The extracted text is over 2 MiB. Choose fewer pages.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入查詢問題，長度不得超過 4 KiB。
translations.en: Enter a question of up to 4 KiB.

translations.zh-Hant: 文件查詢的執行限制無效。
translations.en: The document question’s limits aren’t valid.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型要求的頁面或 UTF-8 讀取範圍無效。
translations.en: The page or UTF-8 range the model asked for isn’t valid.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋詞或搜尋結果數量超過限制。
translations.en: The search terms or number of results went over the limit.

translations.zh-Hant: 回答引文無法在本次實際讀取範圍逐字核對。
translations.en: The answer’s quotations couldn’t be matched word for word with what was read.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型未提供有效的單一步驟文件指令。
translations.en: The model didn’t give a valid single-step document command.

translations.zh-Hant: 文件查詢已達回合或內容上限，尚未完成。
translations.en: The document question reached its round or content limit before finishing.

translations.zh-Hant: 文件查詢的回應超過資料上限。
translations.en: The document question’s reply went over the data limit.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消文件查詢，沒有傳送新的讀取內容。
translations.en: The document question was cancelled; no new text was sent.

translations.zh-Hant: 文件查詢已超過執行時間，尚未完成。
translations.en: The document question ran out of time before finishing.

translations.zh-Hant: 來源或模型設定已變更，請重新確認目的服務。
translations.en: The source or model settings changed. Confirm the model service again.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務未完成文件查詢，沒有自動重試。
translations.en: The model service didn’t finish the document question, and it wasn’t retried automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: 請選取文字稿或字幕檔。
translations.en: Select a transcript or subtitle file.

translations.zh-Hant: 請核對檔名與讀取範圍，尚未讀取內容。
translations.en: Check the file name and what will be read. Nothing has been read yet.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在讀取核准的文字檔，尚未傳送模型…
translations.en: Reading the approved text file; nothing has been sent to the model…

translations.zh-Hant: 已讀取文字快照。請核對目的服務，再明確開始模型整理。
translations.en: Text snapshot read. Check the model service, then start organizing it.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在請模型整理（第 %1$lld 回合）…
translations.en: Asking the model to organize it (round %1$lld)…

translations.zh-Hant: 模型已讀取 %1$lld／%2$lld 位元組。
模型指令格式無效；正在要求一次格式修正，尚未執行該動作。
translations.en: The model’s command format was invalid; asking it once to fix the format. That action wasn’t run.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型指令格式仍無效，本次整理已停止。
translations.en: The model’s command format is still invalid, so this was stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 全文讀取與原文證據逐字核對已完成；請再核對整理內容。
translations.en: The full text was read and the source quotations were checked word for word. Check the organized content.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型未完成整理，沒有新增記憶或技能。
translations.en: The model didn’t finish; no memories or skills were added.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型設定已變更；已交付的整理與原文仍保留，再次整理前請重新確認目的服務。
translations.en: Model settings changed. The delivered result and source text are kept; confirm the model service again before organizing again.

translations.zh-Hant: 已接收你核准的文字快照。請確認目的服務，再明確開始模型整理。
translations.en: Received the text snapshot you approved. Confirm the model service, then start organizing it.

translations.zh-Hant: 選檔未完成，尚未讀取新的內容。
translations.en: File selection didn’t finish; nothing new was read.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次參考資料已撤銷；請確認目前設定與目的服務後重新整理。
translations.en: This session’s reference data was withdrawn. Check the current settings and model service, then try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 整理已停止，已核准的原文仍保留；晚到回覆不會更新結果。
translations.en: Stopped. The approved source text is kept; a late reply won’t change the result.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法完成本次整理，沒有新增記憶或技能。
translations.en: Couldn’t finish organizing this; no memories or skills were added.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取所選檔案，或檔案不是一般檔案；不接受符號連結。
translations.en: The selected file can’t be read or isn’t a regular file; symbolic links aren’t accepted.

translations.zh-Hant: 請選取 UTF-8 的 txt、srt、vtt 或 md 文字檔。
translations.en: Select a UTF-8 txt, srt, vtt or md text file.

translations.zh-Hant: 文字檔超過 64 KiB 上限，請先分成較小的檔案。
translations.en: The text file is over the 64 KiB limit. Split it into smaller files first.

translations.zh-Hant: 檔案不是有效的 UTF-8 文字，或含有不支援的控制字元。
translations.en: The file isn’t valid UTF-8 text or has unsupported control characters.

translations.zh-Hant: 所選檔案沒有可整理的文字。
translations.en: The selected file has no text to organize.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先核對所選檔案並核准本次讀取。
translations.en: Check the selected file and approve reading it first.

translations.zh-Hant: 已停止本次整理，沒有新增記憶或技能。
translations.en: Stopped; no memories or skills were added.

translations.zh-Hant: 檔案提供者未在讀取期限內完成，尚未傳送給模型。
translations.en: The file provider didn’t finish in time; nothing was sent to the model.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回傳的工具格式無效，整理未完成。
translations.en: The model’s tool format was invalid, so this didn’t finish.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型要求的讀取範圍無效；只能依序重疊讀取核准的文字快照。
translations.en: The range the model asked to read isn’t valid; it can only read the approved snapshot in order, with overlap.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型尚未讀完全部文字，不能標示整理完成。
translations.en: The model hasn’t read all the text yet, so this can’t be marked finished.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型的引文或時間無法在已讀原文中逐字核對，整理未完成。
translations.en: The model’s quotations or times couldn’t be matched word for word with the text read, so this didn’t finish.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次整理已達回合或資料上限，尚未完成。
translations.en: This reached its round or data limit before finishing.

translations.zh-Hant: 設定的模型服務未完成要求，請檢查模型設定或連線。
translations.en: The configured model service didn’t complete the request. Check model settings or your connection.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次模型等待已達時間上限，尚未完成。
translations.en: Waiting for the model hit the time limit before finishing.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型設定已變更，本次整理已停止；請重新確認目的服務。
translations.en: Model settings changed, so this stopped. Confirm the model service again.

translations.zh-Hant: 僅整理使用者選取的文字或字幕；不會聽取音訊或觀看影片。
translations.en: Organizes only text or subtitles you choose; it doesn’t listen to audio or watch video.

translations.zh-Hant: 核准後只讀取此檔案，最多 64 KiB、等待最多 30 秒。這一步不會傳送給模型。
translations.en: Once approved, only this file is read, up to 64 KiB, waiting up to 30 seconds. Nothing is sent to the model in this step.

translations.zh-Hant: 開始後，檔名、原文，以及依目前開關選取的個人檔案、記憶與已啟用技能參考會傳至上述服務。參考資料不會成為原文證據；產出不會自動寫入記憶或技能。
translations.en: Once you start, the file name, the source text, and the profile, memories and enabled skill references chosen by your current switches are sent to this service. References never count as source evidence, and the result isn’t written to memory or skills automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: 將這份文字傳給模型並整理
translations.en: Send this text to the model to organize

translations.zh-Hant: 僅依文字來源整理。全部位元組已讀取，下列原文證據已逐字核對；這不代表字幕與影音相符，或所有論點皆已正確摘要。
translations.en: Organized from the text source only. Every byte was read and the source quotations below were checked word for word; this doesn’t mean the subtitles match the audio or video, or that every point was summarized correctly.

translations.zh-Hant: 建立目前網頁可讀取的文字快照，排除表單輸入與隱藏內容。最多 64 KiB，超過時會停止；這一步不會傳送給模型。
translations.en: Makes a snapshot of the readable text on the current page, leaving out form fields and hidden content. Up to 64 KiB; it stops if there’s more. Nothing is sent to the model in this step.

translations.zh-Hant: 文字快照不包含圖片、影音或內嵌頁面的內容。請核對擷取結果；模型只能整理這份快照，不能據此宣稱已讀完整個網站。
translations.en: The snapshot doesn’t include images, audio, video or embedded pages. Check what was captured; the model can only organize this snapshot and can’t claim it read the whole site.

translations.zh-Hant: 此頁有 %1$lld 個內嵌或封裝區域未完整擷取；下方只包含可讀取的文字。
translations.en: Embedded or enclosed areas not fully captured: %1$lld. Below is only the readable text.

translations.zh-Hant: 核准使用這份文字，前往確認模型服務
translations.en: Use this text and confirm the model service

translations.zh-Hant: 此頁文字無法建立有效快照，尚未傳送給模型。
translations.en: Couldn’t make a valid snapshot of this page’s text; nothing was sent to the model.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法建立目前網頁的文字快照；頁面可能尚未載入、已變更，或不符合此功能的網址限制。
translations.en: Couldn’t make a text snapshot of this page. It may not have loaded, may have changed, or its address isn’t allowed here.

translations.zh-Hant: 逐份選取或加入 PDF，最多三份，再依指定順序產生新文件。每個檔案最多 10 MiB，合計最多 200 頁；輸出最多 20 MiB。處理過程不改動原檔，也不會上傳。
translations.en: Select or add PDFs one at a time, up to three, then make a new document in the order you give. Each file can be up to 10 MiB, with up to 200 pages in all; the output can be up to 20 MiB. The originals aren’t changed and nothing is uploaded.

translations.zh-Hant: 目前支援一般靜態 PDF；不支援加密、表單、註記、附件、書籤、標記結構、圖層與互動文件，也不會辨識掃描文字。
translations.en: Plain static PDFs are supported. Encrypted documents, forms, annotations, attachments, bookmarks, tagged structure, layers and interactive documents aren’t, and scanned text isn’t recognized.

translations.zh-Hant: 匯入副本時，系統會在你選檔時建立副本；App 仍會先請你核准讀取，再另行核准產生新 PDF。
translations.en: When you import a copy, the system makes the copy as you choose the file. The app still asks you to approve reading it, and separately to approve making the new PDF.

translations.zh-Hant: 已讀取 %1$lld 頁，%2$lld 位元組
只讀取這個選取的 PDF，最多 10 MiB；不會掃描資料夾或上傳。
translations.en: Reads only this selected PDF, up to 10 MiB. Folders aren’t scanned and nothing is uploaded.

translations.zh-Hant: 加入文件會保留已選來源，但清除本次讀取核准、頁序及尚未儲存的結果；請重新核准各文件。取消選檔則保留原狀。
translations.en: Adding a document keeps the sources you chose but clears this round’s read approvals, page order and any unsaved result; approve each document again. Cancelling the file choice keeps everything as it was.

translations.zh-Hant: 最多三份來源。匯入副本時，系統會在你選檔時建立副本，仍需另行核准讀取。
translations.en: Up to three sources. When you import a copy, the system makes it as you choose the file; reading it still needs your approval.
Page order for the new document

translations.zh-Hant: 格式為「來源編號:頁碼」。例如 1:3,1:1-2,2:1，表示來源 1 的第 3、1、2 頁，再接來源 2 的第 1 頁；頁面可以重複。
translations.en: Use “source:page”. For example, 1:3,1:1-2,2:1 means pages 3, 1 and 2 of source 1, then page 1 of source 2. Pages can repeat.

translations.zh-Hant: 第 %1$lld 頁 ← 來源 %2$lld 第 %3$lld 頁
將依以上頁序產生新的 PDF。請在儲存前再次核對內容。
translations.en: A new PDF is made in this page order. Check its content again before saving.
Approve and make the new PDF

translations.zh-Hant: 已產生 %1$lld 頁，%2$lld 位元組
請對照原頁核對結果。已驗證頁數、旋轉、尺寸及各頁框的相對位置；PDFKit 可能正規化頁框原點與文件編碼，不保證位元相同或保留文件層級中繼資料。
translations.en: Check the result against the original pages. The page count, rotation, size and page box positions were verified; PDFKit may normalize page box origins and the encoding, so the bytes may differ and document-level metadata may not be kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 請選擇新檔名及儲存位置；若選擇取代既有檔案，系統會請你確認。
translations.en: Choose a new file name and location. If you replace an existing file, the system asks you to confirm.

translations.zh-Hant: 取消處理並清除本次選取
PDF 已儲存至所選位置。
translations.en: PDF saved to the location you chose.

translations.zh-Hant: 未能儲存 PDF，結果仍保留；請重新選擇位置。
translations.en: Couldn’t save the PDF; the result is kept. Choose a location again.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消儲存，新 PDF 仍保留。
translations.en: Saving cancelled; the new PDF is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法準備輸出文件，請重新處理來源文件。
translations.en: Couldn’t prepare the file to save. Process the source documents again.

translations.zh-Hant: 每次請只選取一份 PDF，再使用「加入 PDF」加入其他來源。
translations.en: Select one PDF at a time, then use “Add a PDF” for other sources.

translations.zh-Hant: 已加入文件；請重新核准各來源的讀取，再核對新頁序。
translations.en: Document added. Approve reading each source again, then check the new page order.

translations.zh-Hant: 請逐一確認要讀取的文件。
未能取得選取的 PDF，請重新選取。
translations.en: Couldn’t get the selected PDF. Select it again.

translations.zh-Hant: 文件已讀取；請指定新 PDF 的頁面順序。
translations.en: Documents read. Give the page order for the new PDF.

translations.zh-Hant: 文件已讀取；請確認其餘文件。
translations.en: Document read. Confirm the remaining documents.

translations.zh-Hant: 請核對下列頁序，再產生新的 PDF。
translations.en: Check the page order below, then make the new PDF.

translations.zh-Hant: 新 PDF 已產生，尚未儲存至檔案。
translations.en: The new PDF is made but not saved to a file yet.

translations.zh-Hant: 文件處理未完成，原檔未修改。
translations.en: Processing didn’t finish; the originals weren’t changed.

translations.zh-Hant: 請選取一至三個不同的 PDF，再逐一核准讀取。
translations.en: Select one to three different PDFs, then approve reading each one.

translations.zh-Hant: 這個 PDF 有加密或複製／組裝限制；此功能不會移除保護。
translations.en: This PDF is encrypted or restricts copying or assembly; this won’t remove the protection.

translations.zh-Hant: 此版本不處理含表單、註記、附件、書籤、標記結構、圖層或互動功能的頁面／文件。
translations.en: This version doesn’t process pages or documents with forms, annotations, attachments, bookmarks, tagged structure, layers or interactive features.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法產生新的 PDF；原檔未修改。
translations.en: Couldn’t make the new PDF; the originals weren’t changed.

translations.zh-Hant: 新 PDF 的頁數、旋轉或尺寸驗證失敗，未交付結果。
translations.en: The new PDF failed the page count, rotation or size check, so it wasn’t delivered.

translations.zh-Hant: 新 PDF 超過 20 MiB，請減少頁數或來源檔案。
translations.en: The new PDF is over 20 MiB. Use fewer pages or source files.

translations.zh-Hant: 想核對的問題、地區與時間範圍
translations.en: Question to check, with region and time range

translations.zh-Hant: 確認後會讀取這些公開來源及同站連結，並將頁面摘錄傳給已設定的模型。研究使用獨立網站資料，不使用手動瀏覽的登入狀態。
translations.en: Once confirmed, these public sources and links on the same sites are read, and page excerpts are sent to the configured model. Research uses separate website data, not the sign-ins from your own browsing.

translations.zh-Hant: 引文已對應實際讀取頁面；不代表來源互相獨立或結論已證實。網站知識與路線不會自動寫入。
translations.en: Quotations match pages that were actually read. That doesn’t mean the sources are independent or the conclusion is proven. Website notes and routes aren’t saved automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: 發布日期：未確認；請參考原文引句。
translations.en: Publication date: not confirmed; see the quoted text.

translations.zh-Hant: 輸入問題與來源，確認後開始讀取。
translations.en: Enter a question and sources, then confirm to start reading.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在讀取已確認的來源…
已交付部分結果；仍有來源或證據不足。
translations.en: Delivered a partial result; some sources or evidence are missing.

translations.zh-Hant: 已整理多來源引用；來源獨立性與內容仍需判讀。
translations.en: Organized citations from several sources; you still need to judge their independence and content.

translations.zh-Hant: 研究未完成；實際讀取紀錄保留。
translations.en: The research didn’t finish; the record of pages read is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先在設定完成模型服務與金鑰設定。
translations.en: First set up the model service and key in Settings.

translations.zh-Hant: 請檢查研究問題與來源網址。
translations.en: Check the research question and source addresses.

translations.zh-Hant: 已讀取 %1$lld 個頁面，正在核對來源…
有來源暫時無法讀取，會標示資料不足。
translations.en: A source can’t be read right now; it will be marked as missing data.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消研究；已讀取紀錄保留，晚到回應不會更新結果。
translations.en: Research cancelled. The record of pages read is kept, and a late reply won’t change the result.

translations.zh-Hant: %1$@ 起始頁未能讀取；不能據此判斷該網站沒有相關資訊。
translations.en: %1$@: the start page couldn’t be read, so this doesn’t show the site has nothing relevant.

translations.zh-Hant: %1$@ 後續頁面未能讀取，保留先前摘錄。
translations.en: %1$@: later pages couldn’t be read; earlier excerpts are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型重複同一操作，已停止。尚未完成交叉核對。
translations.en: The model repeated the same action, so it stopped. Cross-checking isn’t finished.

translations.zh-Hant: 遇到重複頁面，已停止；尚未完成交叉核對。
translations.en: It hit a repeated page and stopped. Cross-checking isn’t finished.

translations.zh-Hant: 已達共同模型回合上限；尚未取得符合引用要求的回答。
translations.en: Reached the shared model round limit without an answer that meets the citation rules.

translations.zh-Hant: 回答只引用一個來源，尚未完成多來源核對。
translations.en: The answer cites only one source, so the multi-source check isn’t finished.

translations.zh-Hant: 已讀內容超過本次模型輸入上限，請縮小研究範圍；實際讀取紀錄保留。
translations.en: What was read is over this model’s input limit. Narrow the research; the record of pages read is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 請填寫研究問題與 2 至 3 個不同網站的公開 HTTPS 起始網址；不可包含帳密、查詢參數或登入路徑。
translations.en: Enter a research question and public HTTPS start addresses on 2 to 3 different sites, without credentials, query parameters or sign-in paths.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回傳了不支援的研究指令；已停止，保留實際讀取紀錄。
translations.en: The model sent an unsupported research command, so it stopped. The record of pages read is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回傳的研究指令格式仍無法辨識，已停止研究。
translations.en: The model’s research command still couldn’t be read, so the research stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型引用無法對應這次讀到的原文；未將該回答當成研究成果。
translations.en: The model’s quotations don’t match the text read this time, so the answer wasn’t used as a result.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面離開已確認的來源範圍；已停止讀取。
translations.en: A page left the confirmed sources, so reading stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型使用了過期的頁面或連結編號；未執行該導覽。
translations.en: The model used an out-of-date page or link number, so that step wasn’t taken.

translations.zh-Hant: 多網站研究已達整體時間限制；已讀取紀錄保留。
translations.en: Multi-site research reached its overall time limit; the record of pages read is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 按下搜尋後，搜尋詞會傳送至 html.duckduckgo.com；不會傳送模型金鑰或既有網站登入狀態。搜尋摘要只用來尋找來源，尚未讀取候選網頁正文。
translations.en: When you search, your search terms are sent to html.duckduckgo.com. Model keys and existing website sign-ins aren’t sent. Search snippets are only used to find sources; the candidate pages themselves aren’t read yet.

translations.zh-Hant: 選取兩至三個不同網站
translations.en: Choose two or three different sites

translations.zh-Hant: 選取順序就是研究來源順序。這些連結來自搜尋頁，尚未核對內容；套用後仍需確認來源才會開始研究。
translations.en: The order you choose is the order of the research sources. These links come from the search page and haven’t been checked; after applying them you still confirm the sources before research starts.

translations.zh-Hant: 只顯示本次搜尋頁可處理的部分結果。
translations.en: Only part of the results this search page could handle are shown.
Apply and replace the source fields

translations.zh-Hant: 找到 %1$lld 個候選來源；尚未讀取網頁正文。
translations.en: Found %1$lld candidate sources; the pages themselves aren’t read yet.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋未能完成，請稍後再試。
translations.en: The search didn’t finish. Try again later.

translations.zh-Hant: 請選取最多三個不同網站的來源。
translations.en: Choose sources from up to three different sites.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋已取消，搜尋詞仍保留。
translations.en: Search cancelled; your search terms are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋詞過長或含有無法處理的字元，請縮短後再試。
translations.en: The search terms are too long or have characters that can’t be handled. Shorten them and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 這次搜尋已結束，請重新建立搜尋。
translations.en: This search has ended. Start a new one.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋已取消，晚到的頁面不會加入候選來源。
translations.en: Search cancelled; a page arriving late won’t be added to the candidates.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋超過時間限制，未自動重試或改用其他服務。
translations.en: The search ran out of time. It wasn’t retried or sent to another service.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋頁尚未顯示，請重新開啟來源探索。
translations.en: The search page isn’t showing yet. Open source search again.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法建立獨立搜尋環境，尚未傳送搜尋詞。
translations.en: Couldn’t set up a separate search environment; your search terms weren’t sent.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋頁要求離開已確認的供應者或執行不支援的操作，已停止。
translations.en: The search page tried to leave the confirmed provider or do something unsupported, so it stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋頁未能載入，未產生候選來源。
translations.en: The search page didn’t load; no candidates were found.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋服務未回傳可讀取的 HTML 頁面。
translations.en: The search service didn’t return a readable HTML page.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋頁超過可檢查的大小限制，未產生候選來源。
translations.en: The search page is too large to check; no candidates were found.

translations.zh-Hant: 擷取搜尋結果時頁面已變更，未採用候選來源。
translations.en: The page changed while results were captured, so no candidates were used.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋服務要求驗證、登入或未提供可辨識的結果；這次無法探索來源。
translations.en: The search service asked for verification or sign-in, or gave no usable results, so sources can’t be found this time.

translations.zh-Hant: 這次未找到符合現有研究網址政策的直接連結；不能據此判斷網路上沒有相關資料。
translations.en: No direct links meeting the research address rules were found this time; that doesn’t mean there’s nothing relevant online.

translations.zh-Hant: 請從本次結果選取最多三個不同網站的來源。
translations.en: Choose sources from up to three different sites in these results.

translations.zh-Hant: 幫我寫一則友善的訊息回覆
translations.en: Help me write a friendly reply to this message.

translations.zh-Hant: 在內建瀏覽器找一篇最近的 AI 新聞，摘要三個重點
translations.en: Find a recent AI news article in the built-in browser and summarize three key points.

translations.zh-Hant: 在 momo 購物找 1,000 元以內、4.5 星以上的無線耳機，比較三款的優缺點
translations.en: Find three wireless earbuds under NT$1,000 rated 4.5 stars or more on momo and compare their pros and cons.

translations.zh-Hant: 記住我偏好使用繁體中文，回答簡短一點
translations.en: Remember that I prefer concise answers in Traditional Chinese.
What preferences have I told you to remember?

translations.zh-Hant: 在 104 人力銀行搜尋台北的 AI 產品經理職缺，挑五個幫我比較
translations.en: Search 104 Job Bank for AI product manager jobs in Taipei and compare five of them for me.

translations.zh-Hant: 裝置是淺色就淺色，深色就深色
translations.en: Light or dark, whichever the device is in

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入完整的 HTTPS Base URL，不可包含帳密、查詢參數或片段。
translations.en: Enter a full HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.

translations.zh-Hant: 請填寫服務供應商提供的模型名稱。
translations.en: Enter the model name supplied by your service provider.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入 API Key。已有儲存的金鑰時，同一服務可留空沿用。
translations.en: Enter an API key. Leave it blank to reuse a saved key for the same service.

translations.zh-Hant: 服務主機或連接埠已變更，請重新輸入該服務的 API Key；不會自動沿用舊金鑰。
translations.en: The service host or port changed. Enter its API key again; the old key is not reused automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: API Key 不可包含空白或控制字元。
translations.en: The API key must not contain whitespace or control characters.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法存取 Keychain，設定未變更。請解鎖裝置後再試。
translations.en: Keychain is unavailable. Settings were not changed. Unlock the device and retry.

translations.zh-Hant: Keychain 存取失敗（系統代碼 %1$@），設定未變更。
translations.en: Keychain access failed (system code %1$@). Settings were not changed.

translations.zh-Hant: 伺服器未宣告工具能力
translations.en: The server did not declare tool support

translations.zh-Hant: 支援 HTTPS Streamable HTTP。連線後選取要提供給對話模型的工具，再到對話開啟 MCP。模型會直接執行已選取的工具，不會每次先問你，所以只選你允許它使用的工具；工具說明及結果會送給已設定的模型。
translations.en: Supports HTTPS Streamable HTTP. Connect, select tools for the conversation model, then enable MCP in chat. The model runs selected tools without asking you each time, so select only tools you allow it to use. Tool descriptions and results are sent to your configured model.

translations.zh-Hant: 還沒有可選的模型。先新增一個服務商。
translations.en: No models to choose from yet. Add a provider first.

translations.zh-Hant: 這一版還不會向服務商要模型列表。在服務商下面填它說明文件裡的模型名，按「使用」會先試呼叫一次，通了才換。
translations.en: This version doesn’t ask providers for their model lists yet. Under a provider, enter a model name from its docs; “Use” makes one test call first and switches only if it works.

translations.zh-Hant: 點一個模型，可以把它用作主模型，或設定它能不能看圖。
translations.en: Tap a model to use it as the main model or say whether it can see images.

translations.zh-Hant: 這家是跳過測試存下的，還不知道能不能用。選一個模型時會先試呼叫，也可以點「重新測試」。
translations.en: This provider was saved without a test, so nothing is known about whether it works. Pick a model to test it, or tap “Test again”.

translations.zh-Hant: 這家的 API Key 會一起刪掉。
translations.en: Its API key will be deleted too.
%1$@ uses it; you’ll need to choose again after deleting.

translations.zh-Hant: 它沒在給任何用途幹活。
translations.en: It isn’t used for any role.

translations.zh-Hant: 已刪除「%1$@」和它的 API Key。
設定已儲存，但舊的 API Key 沒能刪掉；下次開啟 App 會再清一次。
translations.en: Saved, but the old API key couldn’t be deleted; the app tries again the next time it opens.

translations.zh-Hant: %1$@（%2$@）會收到下面這些內容，好讓它的模型回覆你：
translations.en: %1$@ (%2$@) will receive the following so its model can reply:

translations.zh-Hant: 你在對話裡輸入的文字
附件在這台裝置上讀出的文字（每個檔案最多 32 KB，一則訊息合計最多 64 KB）
translations.en: Text read from your attachments on this device (up to 32 KB per file and 64 KB per message)

translations.zh-Hant: 打開「能看圖」時，你附上的圖片
translations.en: Photos you attach, when “Can see images” is on

translations.zh-Hant: 跟對話一起送出的個人檔案
translations.en: Your profile, sent along with conversations

translations.zh-Hant: 研究網站或執行任務時讀到的網頁文字
translations.en: Text of web pages read during research and tasks

translations.zh-Hant: 研究網站時，請模型判斷結果的請求
translations.en: Requests during research that ask the model to judge the results

translations.zh-Hant: 加進對話的記憶搜尋結果
translations.en: Memory search results added to the conversation
The content of skills that are used

translations.zh-Hant: 開啟「自動記住我說過的事」時，每次回覆後自動整理記憶的請求，含你說的話和相關的記憶
translations.en: With “Remember what I say automatically” on, the request after each reply that organizes your memories, with what you said and related memories

translations.zh-Hant: MCP 工具和資源回傳的結果
translations.en: Results from MCP tools and resources

translations.zh-Hant: %1$@ 是你自己選的第三方服務，會按它自己的條款和隱私權政策處理這些資料；渥屋助理不會把它們傳到其他地方。
translations.en: %1$@ is a third-party service you chose. It handles this data under its own terms and privacy policy; woowtech agent doesn’t send it anywhere else.

translations.zh-Hant: 不同意的話，什麼都不會傳出去，這家服務商也不會儲存。
translations.en: If you don’t agree, nothing is sent and this provider isn’t saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 不同意的話，什麼都不會傳出去，主模型維持不變。
translations.en: If you don’t agree, nothing is sent and the main model stays as it is.

translations.zh-Hant: 不同意的話，什麼都不會傳出去：這則訊息不會送出，草稿會保留。
translations.en: If you don’t agree, nothing is sent: this message stays unsent and your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 之後改用別家服務商的模型時，會再問你一次。
translations.en: You’ll be asked again before a model from another provider is used.

translations.zh-Hant: 沒有送出：你沒有同意把內容傳給 %1$@。草稿已保留。
translations.en: Not sent: you didn’t agree to send your content to %1$@. Your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 服務商已達上限，請先刪除不用的服務商。
translations.en: You’ve reached the provider limit. Delete one you don’t use first.

translations.zh-Hant: 還沒有同意把內容傳給這家服務商，設定未變更。
translations.en: You haven’t agreed to send your content to this provider; nothing was changed.

translations.zh-Hant: 僅顯示此裝置已加密保存的完整問答。
translations.en: Only completed exchanges in this device’s encrypted archive appear here.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取加密對話；原檔保留，請解鎖後重新讀取。
translations.en: Could not read the encrypted archive. The original file is retained; unlock and reload.

translations.zh-Hant: 釘選變更未保存；對話維持原狀。請重新開啟再試。
translations.en: The pin change was not saved. The conversation is unchanged; reopen it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入非空白的單行標題，且不要過長。
translations.en: Enter a nonempty, single-line title that is not too long.

translations.zh-Hant: 改名未保存；對話內容不變。請重新開啟再試。
translations.en: The new title was not saved. The conversation is unchanged; reopen it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 任務進行中，請先返回處理。
translations.en: A task is running. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 有待核准的操作，請先返回處理。
translations.en: An action awaits your review. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 草稿或 PDF 附件未送出，請先返回處理。
translations.en: An unsent draft or PDF attachment is present. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 目前答覆尚未保存，請先返回處理。
translations.en: The current reply has not been saved. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務或金鑰身分不同；可在完整歷史中檢視。
translations.en: The model service or key identity differs. You can view it in full history.

translations.zh-Hant: 選取的 PDF 尚未送出；開啟新對話會移除附件。
translations.en: The selected PDF has not been sent. Starting a new conversation removes the attachment.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次回覆尚未保存；開啟新對話會清除畫面中的回覆，並放棄重試保存。
translations.en: This reply has not been saved. Starting a new conversation clears the reply and gives up the save retry.

translations.zh-Hant: 未完成的回覆片段尚未保存；開啟新對話會清除它。
translations.en: The unfinished reply preview has not been saved. Starting a new conversation clears it.

translations.zh-Hant: 已有的純文字草稿會保留。
translations.en: Your unsent text draft will remain.

translations.zh-Hant: 等待你核對個人檔案修改…
translations.en: Waiting for you to review profile changes…
Waiting for you to review memory changes…

translations.zh-Hant: 正在使用 MCP 處理對話…
請先到設定填寫模型服務與 API Key。
translations.en: Set up a model service and API key in Settings first.

translations.zh-Hant: 還缺:還沒有能用的模型
UI 測試模式：固定回覆，不會呼叫網路。
translations.en: UI test mode: fixed replies; no network calls.

translations.zh-Hant: 已完成的問答會加密保存在此裝置；未完成任務與未送出的草稿不會保存。工具操作不會還原；開啟歷史不會自動傳送。
translations.en: Completed exchanges are encrypted on this device. Unfinished tasks and unsent drafts are not saved. Tool actions are not restored, and opening history does not send anything.

translations.zh-Hant: 只搜尋本次選取並核准擷取的頁面；沒有 OCR，也不傳送資料。
translations.en: Searches only the pages selected and approved for this extraction. No OCR or data transmission.

translations.zh-Hant: 不區分英文字母大小寫（A–Z）
支援文字、.、\d、\w、\s、字元類別如 [A-Z0-9] 或 [^0-9]、+、*、固定次數 {n}（1–16）及跳脫符號；例：[A-Z]+。只列非空匹配，不支援 ?、群組、或跨行。
translations.en: Use text, ., \d, \w, \s, classes such as [A-Z0-9] or [^0-9], +, *, {n} exact repeats (1–16), and escaped symbols; e.g. [A-Z]+. Empty matches are omitted. No ?, groups, alternation, or cross-line matches.

translations.zh-Hant: 正規表示式為空或格式無效，請檢查後重試。
translations.en: The pattern is empty or malformed. Check it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 此寫法尚未支援；請使用上方列出的有限語法。
translations.en: This syntax is not supported. Use the limited syntax listed above.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋已達上限而停止。若單頁過長，請改用字面搜尋；否則可縮小頁數或簡化條件。沒有顯示不完整結果。
translations.en: Search reached a limit. For an oversized single page, use literal search; otherwise select fewer pages or simplify the pattern. Partial results are not shown.

translations.zh-Hant: 輸入文字，最多 256 UTF-8 位元組
translations.en: Enter text, up to 256 UTF-8 bytes

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入 1–256 UTF-8 位元組的非空白搜尋文字，不能包含控制字元。
translations.en: Enter 1–256 UTF-8 bytes of nonblank search text without control characters.
Search did not finish. Try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次擷取頁面沒有符合的文字。
translations.en: No matches in the extracted pages.

translations.zh-Hant: 找到 %1$lld 處；還有其他符合位置。
這次擷取結果無法建立搜尋快照，請確認已擷取可讀取的文字。
translations.en: Could not create a search snapshot. Make sure readable text was extracted.

translations.zh-Hant: 按住說話，上滑取消，放開加入草稿。VoiceOver 可啟動開始及結束，或選擇取消語音輸入動作。
translations.en: Hold to speak, slide up to cancel, release to add to draft. With VoiceOver, activate to start and stop, or choose the cancel voice input action.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在聆聽，放開加入草稿；上滑取消
translations.en: Listening. Release to add to draft; slide up to cancel.

translations.zh-Hant: 未聽清楚，請按住說話再試一次。
translations.en: No speech recognized. Hold and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 麥克風權限已關閉，請至設定開啟後再試。
translations.en: Microphone access is off. Enable it in Settings and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 語音辨識權限已關閉，請至設定開啟後再試。
translations.en: Speech recognition access is off. Enable it in Settings and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 此裝置的語音辨識受到限制，請檢查裝置限制。
translations.en: Speech recognition is restricted on this device. Check device restrictions.

translations.zh-Hant: 目前無法使用裝置上語音辨識，請使用鍵盤；服務商語音轉文字尚未支援。
translations.en: On-device speech recognition is unavailable. Use the keyboard; provider transcription is not yet supported.

translations.zh-Hant: 音訊無法使用或已中斷，請檢查麥克風及音訊裝置後再試。
translations.en: Audio is unavailable or was interrupted. Check your microphone and audio route, then try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 語音辨識逾時，請再試一次。
translations.en: Speech recognition timed out. Please try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 語音輸入已中斷；如果剛完成授權，請再次按住說話。
translations.en: Voice input was interrupted. If you just granted access, hold to speak again.

translations.zh-Hant: 邊說邊出字；離線辨識需支援目前語言並具備語言包
translations.en: Shows words as you speak; offline recognition requires a supported language pack

translations.zh-Hant: 這台裝置沒有可用的語音辨識
translations.en: This device has no usable speech recognition
The text box can’t be held to talk
Choose on-device recognition or turn it off

translations.zh-Hant: 語音輸入已關閉或選項不可用；請在模型設定的「語音轉文字」中選擇。
translations.en: Voice input is off or the choice is unavailable. Choose an option in model settings under Speech to text.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法儲存語音設定，請再試一次。
translations.en: Could not save the voice setting. Try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 你允許渥屋助理存取的照片
translations.en: Photos you let Woow Assistant access

translations.zh-Hant: 在這裡直接選照片,需要允許渥屋助理存取照片
translations.en: To pick photos here, allow Woow Assistant to access your photos

translations.zh-Hant: 不允許也可以點上面的「相簿」,用系統的照片選擇器
translations.en: Without access, tap Photos above to use the system photo picker
This attachment is no longer available
Up to %1$lld attachments at a time

translations.zh-Hant: 一次最多 %1$lld 個附件,另外 %2$lld 個沒加上
translations.en: Up to %1$lld attachments at a time; %2$lld more were not added

translations.zh-Hant: 沒能新增:%1$@(單個檔案不超過 200 MB)
translations.en: Couldn’t add: %1$@ (each file must be 200 MB or less)

translations.zh-Hant: 未確認:它能看圖就打開,聊天附上的圖片會直接交給它看。
translations.en: Not confirmed: turn this on if it can see images, and photos attached in chat go straight to it.

translations.zh-Hant: 按你的設定。打開時,聊天附上的圖片會直接交給主模型看。
translations.en: As you set it. When on, photos attached in chat go straight to the main model.

zh-Hant.other: 這個模型不能看圖,%lld 張圖片沒有交給模型。可到設定的模型頁打開「能看圖」。

en.one: This model can’t see images, so %lld image wasn’t sent to it. Turn on Sees images on the model settings page.
en.other: This model can’t see images, so %lld images weren’t sent to it. Turn on Sees images on the model settings page.

translations.en: Press and hold the text to select it
Re-add the attachments you want to include

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：API Key 無效或沒有權限。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the API key is invalid or has no access. Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：額度已用完。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the account has run out of credit. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：請求太頻繁，請稍後再試。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: too many requests; try again later. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：服務商那裡沒有這個模型。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the provider has no such model. Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：網路連線失敗。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: couldn’t connect to the model service. Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：回覆還沒傳完，連線就中斷了。請稍後再試。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the connection dropped before the reply finished. Try again later. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：看不懂回傳的內容，請確認介面網址和介面類型是否相符。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: its reply couldn’t be read; check that the base URL and API type match. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：伺服器端出錯（HTTP %1$lld）。請稍後再試。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the server returned an error (HTTP %1$lld). Try again later. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：伺服器端出錯（HTTP %1$lld）。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the server returned an error (HTTP %1$lld). Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.
